dashboard.label: Fleet overview
dashboard.description: Vulnerability posture across every host reporting a swinv inventory.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_feedstate_lookup | where isnotnull(imported_at) | eval age_days = round((now() - imported_at)/86400, 1) | fields age_days
index=riskability_inventory sourcetype=riskability:swinv earliest=-7d | stats dc(hostname) AS hosts
`riskability_latest_inventory` | riskabilitymatch include_informational=true | stats count BY confidence
`riskability_latest_inventory` | riskabilitymatch | stats dc(cve_id) AS cves, dc(package) AS packages BY hostname | sort - cves | head 20

panel.title: Known-exploited vulnerabilities present in the fleet (CISA KEV)

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | riskabilitymatch | where isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added!="" | stats dc(hostname) AS hosts, values(package) AS packages BY cve_id, kev_added, kev_due, epss | sort - hosts
